profiles.notes: Each qualification is an alternative route. Check the track length and applicant background in the individual rule.

requirements.label: Five-year track · GCE A levels
requirements.details: Present three A levels at A or B: biology, chemistry and either mathematics or physics. SGU may accept a strong third A level in a non-science subject if the applicant also took mathematics or physics at AS level.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Five-year track · approved foundation programmes
requirements.details: An SGU-approved science or medical foundation programme is an alternative entry qualification for the five-year route.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Six-year track · further education qualifications
requirements.details: SGU lists AS levels, the Baccalaureate, South African Matric, the Higher School Exam and the Irish Leaving Certificate as routes to the second preclinical or preveterinary year.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

profiles.notes: Each qualification is an alternative route. Check the track length and applicant background in the individual rule.

requirements.label: Five-year MD · India 10+2
requirements.details: The Indian Senior Secondary School Certificate route requires an average of at least 80% across biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics and English. Applicants who have not taken or passed mathematics may need pre-sessional mathematics.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Six-year MD · BTEC science diploma
requirements.details: A BTEC applicant must hold a diploma in the appropriate sciences with Distinction grades.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Six-year MD · secondary school diploma
requirements.details: For a secondary or American high school diploma, SGU requires at least a 90% overall average with strong performance in science subjects.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Seven-year MD · IGCSE in Grenada
requirements.details: For entry to preclinical year one in Grenada, earn B or above in at least six IGCSE subjects, including biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics and English.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Seven-year MD · secondary school diploma
requirements.details: The Grenada-only seven-year track lists a secondary or American high school diploma as an alternative to IGCSEs. The entry table gives no percentage for this route.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: MD application channels and fee
requirements.details: Apply through SGU or use an existing AMCAS, AACOMAS or TMDSAS application. SGU charges no application fee.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Application process

requirements.label: MD transcripts and recommendations
requirements.details: Supply official transcripts from each college, university and professional school attended. Submit either two recommendation letters or one health committee letter.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Supporting documents

requirements.label: MD selection interview
requirements.details: After an initial review of the application and supporting documents, the committee selects applicants for an interview. It considers academic strengths alongside experience and personal attributes.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Selection and interview

profiles.notes: Each qualification is an alternative route. Check the track length and applicant background in the individual rule.

requirements.label: Five-year DVM · India 10+2 or CBSE
requirements.details: For preveterinary year three, earn at least an 80% average across biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics and English, with no individual grade below 80% in those subjects.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Six-year DVM · secondary diploma and Advanced Placement
requirements.details: For entry to preveterinary year two, the secondary diploma route calls for exceptional science performance with APs. The table also lists SABIS High School. SGU gives no numerical AP score here.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Six-year DVM · West African Senior School Certificate Examination
requirements.details: Earn B2 or better in at least six WASSCE subjects, including biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics and English, for entry to preveterinary year two.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: Seven-year DVM · IGCSE
requirements.details: For preveterinary year one, the table lists strong science performance and at least six grades of B or higher, including biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics and English. SGU notes regional variation.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Entry requirements by track

requirements.label: DVM application channels
requirements.details: Apply to the January or August term through SGU or VMCAS. Send VMCAS supporting materials directly to that service. SGU requires no supplemental application or fee for VMCAS applicants.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Application process

requirements.label: DVM direct application · transcripts and recommendations
requirements.details: Direct applicants must submit official transcripts from each college, university and professional school attended, plus two recommendation letters or one health committee letter. A veterinarian's letter is recommended.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Supporting documents

requirements.label: DVM selection interview
requirements.details: An initial review considers academic achievement, animal experience and other attributes. Selected applicants are invited to interview with an alumnus before final review.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Application review and interview

profiles.notes: Direct admission to the four-year professional degree after university study. Country-specific conditions are identified in each rule.

requirements.label: Four-year MD · prior degree
requirements.details: US and Canadian applicants need a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution. Other applicants need a bachelor's degree with a strong science background.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · US and Canadian science prerequisites
requirements.details: Complete one year each of general biology or zoology, inorganic chemistry (general or physical), and organic chemistry, all with labs. Complete one semester of physics with lab. SGU also accepts equivalent coursework.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · US and Canadian mathematics and English prerequisites
requirements.details: Complete one semester of college or university mathematics at the 100 level and one semester of English, or equivalent coursework.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · MCAT by applicant background
requirements.details: US applicants must submit an MCAT score. Canadians must submit one if they have already taken or scheduled the MCAT. Applicants from outside North America are exempt.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · English-language evidence
requirements.details: For non-US and non-Canadian applicants from countries outside UKVI's English-speaking list, SGU requires an English test. A degree from an English-speaking country can support a waiver request.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · IELTS or Password-Skills
requirements.details: When English testing is required, IELTS Academic or UKVI requires 7.0 overall and in each band. SGU applies the same scoring criteria to Password-Skills.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · internet-based TOEFL
requirements.details: On the scale printed by SGU, the required TOEFL overall score is 5, with listening 5, reading 5, speaking 4.5 and writing 5.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year MD · Cambridge, Duolingo or Kaplan English tests
requirements.details: SGU lists three other choices. Cambridge C1 Advanced requires 185 overall and in each band, Duolingo requires 130 overall and in each band, and Kaplan requires 510 overall and in each band.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Medicine (MD) · Four-year programme requirements

profiles.notes: Direct admission to the four-year professional degree after university study. Country-specific conditions are identified in each rule.

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · degree or exceptional credit route
requirements.details: SGU normally expects a bachelor's degree from an accredited university. The selection committee may consider exceptional applicants with at least 60 undergraduate credits.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · US and Canadian biology and chemistry prerequisites
requirements.details: Complete one year of general biology or zoology with lab, one year of general chemistry with lab, and a semester each of organic chemistry with lab, genetics and biochemistry.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · US and Canadian physics, maths and English
requirements.details: Complete one semester each of physics with lab, English and mathematics. SGU lists calculus, computer science and statistics as mathematics options.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · prerequisite completion for US and Canadian applicants
requirements.details: Apply with 70% of prerequisite courses complete. Prerequisites must be taken at an accredited institution within ten years of intended entry. Pass or Satisfactory must correspond to C− or higher. Survey courses are ineligible.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · in-person coursework and laboratories
requirements.details: For US and Canadian prerequisites, complete at least 60% in person, including all labs. The committee may consider exceptions for spring 2020 through fall 2021. Laboratory exceptions need committee approval.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · prerequisite substitutions and quarter credits
requirements.details: For US and Canadian applicants, submit the school's substitution form for unlisted equivalent courses. Divide quarter units by 1.5 to check the equivalent semester hours.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · animal experience
requirements.details: For US and Canadian applicants, the committee considers animal experience without prescribing a minimum number of hours. It encourages work with both companion and large animals and also considers exotic or laboratory animal, research and regulatory experience.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

requirements.label: Four-year DVM · English proficiency
requirements.details: For applicants outside the US and Canada whose country is outside UKVI's English-speaking list, SGU lists IELTS 7.0 in each band or TOEFL 100 overall. An undergraduate degree from an English-speaking country can support a waiver request for committee review.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Four-year programme requirements

profiles.notes: Exceptional transfer into the four-year veterinary programme.

requirements.label: DVM transfer eligibility
requirements.details: SGU considers transfers only in rare cases after at least two semesters at an AVMA-accredited veterinary school and no more than two years of study. Applicants must be in good standing with no warnings, probation or dismissal. Admitted applicants may need to repeat one or two terms.

source.title: SGU · Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) · Transfer applications
